metadata.feature-description: Create a test document generation feature that allows users to generate sample notes with various content types for testing and demonstration purposes

feature-overview.summary: The Test Document Generator feature will provide users with the ability to create pre-populated sample notes containing various markdown content types. This feature is essential for testing the editor's capabilities, demonstrating functionality to new users, and providing a quick way to populate the application with realistic content during development or demos.

purpose.item: Enable quick generation of sample notes with diverse content types
Facilitate testing of the markdown editor's rendering capabilities
Provide demo content for showcasing the application's features
Allow developers and testers to verify all markdown elements render correctly

includes.item: UI component for triggering test document generation
Multiple test document templates with varied content

excludes.item: Persistent storage of test document templates

requirement.title: Test Document Generation UI
requirement.description: Provide a user interface element (button/menu) to trigger test document generation

acceptance-criteria.criterion: UI element is accessible from the main interface
UI element uses consistent styling with existing components
Clicking the element triggers document generation

requirement.title: Multiple Test Document Templates
requirement.description: Support generation of various test document types with different content structures

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Each template demonstrates different markdown features
Templates include: Basic formatting, Lists and checkboxes, Code blocks, Tables, Mixed content

requirement.title: Random Content Generation
requirement.description: Generate varied content within templates to create unique test documents

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Random selection of template on each generation
Randomized content elements (lorem ipsum text, sample code, etc.)

requirement.title: Store Integration
requirement.description: Generated test documents must be properly integrated with the existing notes store

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Generated notes appear in the note list immediately
Generated notes follow the same Note type structure
Newly generated note is automatically selected

requirement.title: Batch Generation Option
requirement.description: Allow users to generate multiple test documents at once

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Option to specify number of documents to generate (1-10)
Batch generation creates varied content across documents
First generated document in batch is selected

requirement.title: Visual Feedback
requirement.description: Provide visual confirmation when test documents are generated

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Toast notification or visual indicator shows generation success
Notification includes count of generated documents

requirement.title: Performance
requirement.description: Test document generation must complete within 100ms for single documents

requirement.title: Type Safety
requirement.description: All new code must be fully typed with TypeScript, no use of 'any' type

requirement.title: Code Consistency
requirement.description: New code must follow existing patterns: component directory structure, BEM CSS, Zustand store patterns

requirement.title: Accessibility
